lines.en: label beachvacation9:
I tried to sleep that night but couldn’t.
lines.zh: 那晚我试图入睡，却没能睡着。

lines.en: Something about the crashing of the waves as they attacked the coast tore me from my rest.
lines.zh: 海浪拍打海岸的声响，把我从睡梦中拽了出来。

lines.en: The bed became a ship.
lines.zh: 床变成了一艘船。

lines.en: And I became lost at sea.
lines.zh: 而我迷失在了海上。

lines.en: So I did what all good captains do-
lines.zh: 于是我做了所有称职的船长都会做的事——

lines.en: Abandoned ship and got the Hell out of there.
lines.zh: 弃船，然后赶紧离开那个鬼地方。

lines.en: scene nightsky
That whole thing about “going down with the ship” never made any sense to me.
lines.zh: 「与船共存亡」那套说法，我从来就没理解过。

lines.en: I mean, who wants to die for a boat?
lines.zh: 我的意思是，谁会想为一艘船去死？

lines.en: If you’re going to die, do it for something wonderful.
lines.zh: 要死，也得为美好的东西而死。

lines.en: Like a girl you love or an idea you believe in.
lines.zh: 比如你爱的女孩，或者你相信的理念。

lines.en: Dying for a boat is just a waste of a life.
lines.zh: 为船而死只是浪费一条命。

lines.en: But I guess there’s no harm in thinning out the crowd if some people are naive enough to believe that there is honor in a death at sea.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，要是有人天真到相信葬身海底是种荣耀，那把这批人筛掉一点也无所谓。

lines.en: Honor has no value in the real world.
lines.zh: 荣耀在现实世界里一文不值。

lines.en: Nothing has value in the real world.
lines.zh: 现实世界里什么都一文不值。

lines.en: But that’s because there is no real world.
lines.zh: 但那是因为根本不存在什么现实世界。

lines.en: There’s only this place, whatever this may be.
lines.zh: 只有这个地方，不管它是什么。

lines.en: Wherever this may be.
lines.zh: 不管它在哪儿。

lines.en: Which is likely somewhere at the edge of the world.
lines.zh: 大概是在世界的边缘吧。

lines.en: scene sanaatnight1
I come across a small girl as I make my way down the beach, still fighting away the idea that I should be in bed right now.
lines.zh: 我沿着海滩往前走，还在和「我现在应该在床上」这个念头搏斗，就在这时遇见了一个小小的女孩。

lines.en: It’s roughly 3 AM. The girls have probably been long-done with their game at this point.
lines.zh: 大概凌晨三点。女生们的游戏这会儿应该早就结束了。

lines.en: I figured Sana would be in bed, but...
lines.zh: 我以为Sana已经睡了，可是……

lines.en: Well, you can clearly see that isn’t the case.
lines.zh: 嗯，你显然看得出来，事实并非如此。

lines.en: The ocean is gentle tonight.
lines.zh: 今晚的海很温柔。

lines.en: Every so often, I watch the tide tickle her feet before running away again.
lines.zh: 我偶尔会看到潮水挠一挠她的脚，然后又跑开。

lines.en: I wonder if the water is cold?
lines.zh: 不知道水凉不凉？

lines.en: It probably is.
lines.zh: 大概挺凉的。

lines.en: There has to be {i}something{/i} cold in this burning world.
lines.zh: 这个灼热的世界里，总得有点{i}冷的东西{/i}。

lines.en: scene sanaatnight2
Oh.
lines.zh: 哦。

lines.en: She’s spotted me.
lines.zh: 她发现我了。

lines.en: I guess my game of “Spy on the loli” is coming to an end.
lines.zh: 看来我这场「偷看小萝莉」的游戏要结束了。

lines.en: That’s fine, though.
lines.zh: 不过没关系。

lines.en: It’s been a little while since Sana and I were alone together.
lines.zh: 我和Sana已经有一阵子没单独相处了。

lines.en: This is a good chance to figure out what it is that brought her out here this late.
lines.zh: 这是个好机会，能弄清楚究竟是什么让她这么晚还跑出来。

lines.en: I hope, if only for a moment, that it’s not to go down with the ship.
lines.zh: 哪怕只有一瞬间，我也希望那不是为了与船共存亡。

lines.en: : What...are you doing here?
lines.zh: : 你……在这儿干什么？

lines.en: : I thought you went to sleep.
lines.zh: : 我以为你睡了。

lines.en: : I did.
lines.zh: : 我是睡了。

lines.en: : Well, I tried to at least. The water kept me up.
lines.zh: : 好吧，至少是试过了。是海水的声音吵得我睡不着。

lines.en: scene sanaatnight3
: Me too.
lines.zh: : 我也是。

lines.en: if ayanesleepover == True:
: It feels a little weird sleeping in an unfamiliar bed, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 睡在不熟悉的床上，感觉有点怪怪的，对吧？

lines.en: : ...Yeah.
I hope she’s not talking about the night I slept in Ayane’s bed...
lines.zh: 希望她说的不是我睡在Ayane床上那一晚……

lines.en: I still don’t really know the best way to talk about that.
lines.zh: 我到现在也不太清楚该怎么谈那件事。

lines.en: else:
: I kind of...need things to be really quiet in order to fall asleep...
lines.zh: : 我有点……需要非常安静才能睡着……

lines.en: : I always have.
lines.zh: : 一直都是这样。

lines.en: : Mind if I stay here and talk to you for a bit? Not like there’s anything else to do right now.
lines.zh: : 我在这儿陪你聊会儿可以吗？反正现在也没别的事可做。

lines.en: : Yeah...that’s fine.
lines.zh: : 嗯……可以啊。

lines.en: scene sanaatnight4
: And sorry for not...asking for permission to go out at night like this.
lines.zh: : 还有，抱歉……我这么晚跑出来，没有……先征求同意。

lines.en: : Even if you’re going to say something like “Do whatever you want” or “I don’t really care.”
lines.zh: : 就算你大概会说「你想怎样就怎样」或者「我其实无所谓」之类的话。

lines.en: : Wow, that’s exactly what I was going to say.
lines.zh: : 哇，这正是我要说的。

lines.en: : I figured...
lines.zh: : 我就知道……

lines.en: scene sanaatnight3
: My mom is the same way.
lines.zh: : 我妈妈也是这样。

lines.en: : She lets me do pretty much anything I want.
lines.zh: : 她基本上我想做什么都让我做。

lines.en: : Yeah, that sounds about right. Sara seems like a pretty lenient mother.
lines.zh: : 嗯，听上去很合理。纱良似乎是个相当宽容的母亲。

lines.en: scene sanaatnight5
: She is.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: : There was...this one time I got lost in a grocery store when I was little...
lines.zh: : 有……这么一次，我小时候在杂货店里走丢了……

lines.en: : And I was crying and looking around for her and...
lines.zh: : 我一边哭一边到处找她，然后……

lines.en: : Well, I didn’t find her until almost thirty minutes later because she went home without me.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我差不多过了三十分钟才找到她，因为她自己回家了，没带上我。

lines.en: : That’s not lenient, that’s just negligent.
lines.zh: : 那不叫宽容，那叫疏忽。

lines.en: scene sanaatnight6
: Yeah...it sounds a lot worse now that I say it out loud...
lines.zh: : 嗯……说出来之后听起来确实更糟了……

lines.en: scene sanaatnight5
: She was really upset about it, though.
lines.zh: : 不过她当时真的很难过。

lines.en: : I remember her crying and...saying how sorry she was for pretty much the rest of the day after that...
lines.zh: : 我记得她一直在哭，而且……那天剩下的时间里一直在说对不起……

lines.en: scene sanaatnight3
: But...I was really little back then, so...it doesn’t really matter anymore.
lines.zh: : 但……那时候我还很小，所以……现在也不重要了。

lines.en: : At the very least...I don’t think I’ll be getting lost in a grocery store again any time soon.
lines.zh: : 至少……我觉得我短时间内不会再在杂货店里走丢了。

lines.en: : It would be concerning if you still got lost in grocery stores at your age.
lines.zh: : 你要是这个年纪还会在杂货店走丢，那才叫人担心。

lines.en: scene sanaatnight6
: I’m glad you think so, but there are plenty of people who still think I’m a lot younger than I actually am.
lines.zh: : 你这么想我很高兴，不过还是有很多人觉得我比实际年龄小很多。

lines.en: : I mean, can you really blame them, though? You’re what, like 4’11?
lines.zh: : 话说回来，这能怪他们吗？你有多高，一米五？

lines.en: : Even shorter...I’m 4’10.
lines.zh: : 还要矮……我一米四七。

lines.en: : {s}Jesus Christ.{/s}
lines.zh: : {s}我的天哪。{/s}

lines.en: : Don’t remind me...
lines.zh: : 别提醒我……

lines.en: : Where do you even buy your clothes?
lines.zh: : 你到底去哪儿买衣服啊？

lines.en: : I just asked you to not remind me and now you’re...asking me where I buy my clothes?
lines.zh: : 我刚让你别提醒我，结果你现在……问我上哪儿买衣服？

lines.en: : ...Maybe I just want to get you a present?
lines.zh: : ……也许我只是想送你件礼物呢？

lines.en: : I’m kind of worried about what a present from you would be like...
lines.zh: : 我有点担心你送的礼物会是什么样……

lines.en: : Rude. I’m a perfectly wholesome adult male, I’ll have you know.
lines.zh: : 真失礼。我可要告诉你，我是个百分之百正派的成年男性。

lines.en: scene sanaatnight3
: You say that now...but I’m pretty sure I’m catching onto what you’re really like, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 你现在是这么说……可我觉得自己已经开始看清你的真面目了，Sensei……

lines.en: I really hope that isn’t true.
lines.zh: 我真希望那不是真的。

lines.en: : Besides...I hear a lot about you from Ayane.
lines.zh: : 而且……我从Ayane那里听了不少关于你的事。

lines.en: I really hope that isn't true either.
lines.zh: 我真希望那也不是真的。

lines.en: : It’s like you’re a different person when you’re with her than you are with me...
lines.zh: : 你和她在一起的时候，简直像是变了一个人，和跟我在一起的时候不一样……

lines.en: : Is it...okay if I ask you why?
lines.zh: : 我……可以问你为什么吗？

lines.en: She’s absolutely correct.
lines.zh: 她说得一点没错。

lines.en: I {i}am{/i} a different person when I’m with her.
lines.zh: 我和她在一起的时候确实{i}是{/i}另一个人。

lines.en: Just like I’m a different person with everyone else.
lines.zh: 就像我跟其他每个人在一起时都是不同的人一样。

lines.en: There isn’t a single person in this world who acts the same with everyone they meet.
lines.zh: 这世上没有一个人，在所有人面前的表现都是一样的。

lines.en: You adapt.
lines.zh: 你会适应。

lines.en: You change yourself to fit better into whatever situation you throw yourself into.
lines.zh: 你会改变自己，好更贴合你投身的那个处境。

lines.en: Such is the way of the chameleon, and such is the way of me.
lines.zh: 变色龙如此，我也如此。

lines.en: : There are a few reasons for that.
lines.zh: : 这有几个原因。

lines.en: : You and Ayane are completely different people. I’ve also known her a lot longer.
lines.zh: : 你和Ayane是完全不同类型的人。而且我认识她的时间长得多。

lines.en: : So Ayane and I are obviously going to act a little closer. Just like how I am with Ami.
lines.zh: : 所以我和Ayane自然会表现得亲近些。就像我和Ami一样。

lines.en: : Ayane’s basically a member of the family at this point.
lines.zh: : Ayane现在基本上已经算是家人了。

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: : 这样啊……

lines.en: : I think...she’d be really happy to hear that.
lines.zh: : 我想……她听到这话一定会很开心。

lines.en: scene sanaatnight7
: She’s...almost like...family for me as well.
lines.zh: : 对我来说，她也……几乎像是……家人一样。

lines.en: : I met her during a...really bad part of my life...
lines.zh: : 我是在……人生中很糟糕的一段时期认识她的……

lines.en: scene sanaatnight3
: I wasn’t always this quiet, you know.
lines.zh: : 我以前并不是这么安静的，你知道吧。

lines.en: : I was actually really talkative when I was little.
lines.zh: : 我小时候其实很爱说话。

lines.en: : I used to get my mom into a lot of trouble.
lines.zh: : 我还经常给我妈妈惹麻烦。

lines.en: scene sanaatnight6
: Which is probably another reason the grocery store fiasco was so scary...I thought she was just giving me away for being too rowdy...
lines.zh: : 这大概也是那次杂货店风波那么吓人的原因之一……我以为她是因为我太闹腾才把我扔掉的……

lines.en: : Actually, I’m going to stop bringing that up now because I feel even dumber every time I add on to it.
lines.zh: : 其实我不打算再提这件事了，因为每补充一句，我就觉得自己更蠢。

lines.en: : I’ll be sure to ask Sara about it the next time I see her, just in case you’re leaving anything out.
lines.zh: : 下次见到纱良我一定问问她，看看你有没有漏掉什么。

lines.en: scene sanaatnight8
: P-Please don’t! She hasn’t brought it up in years and I’m...hoping she forgot about it!
lines.zh: : 拜……拜托别！她已经好多年没提过了，我……希望她忘了！

lines.en: : Do you really think a mother would forget about something like almost losing her daughter?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得一位母亲会忘记差点弄丢女儿这种事？

lines.en: : N-No! But I can still hope!
lines.zh: : 不……不会！但我还是可以抱有希望啊！

lines.en: : Okay, okay. I won’t bring it up. But if she ever does, I’m not stopping her.
lines.zh: : 好好好。我不提了。不过要是她哪天提起来，我可不会拦着她。

lines.en: if saradate1 == True:
scene sanaatnight4
: Oh yeah...You and her are...friends, now...right?
lines.zh: : 哦对了……你和她现在是……朋友了，对吧？

lines.en: : Is that weird for you?
lines.zh: : 这让你觉得别扭吗？

lines.en: : Um...A little bit. I won’t lie.
lines.zh: : 嗯……有一点。我不骗你。

lines.en: : She...hasn’t had any male friends for a long time...so seeing her get close to you is kind of...concerning.
lines.zh: : 她……很久没有男性朋友了……所以看到她和你走得这么近，有点……让人不安。

lines.en: : What, are you worried we’re going to start dating or something?
lines.zh: : 怎么，你怕我们开始交往什么的？

lines.en: scene sanaatnight9
: Yeah.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: I meant that in a joking sort of way but it seems like Sana took it seriously.
lines.zh: 我本来是开玩笑说的，不过Sana似乎当真了。

lines.en: I’m surprised she answered so honestly, though.
lines.zh: 不过她回答得这么坦诚，我挺意外的。

lines.en: Is she already comfortable enough to share her actual feelings with me?
lines.zh: 她已经能自在到跟我分享真实的感受了吗？

lines.en: : It would be...really weird if you two started dating.
lines.zh: : 要是你们两个开始交往，会……很奇怪的。

lines.en: : Why do you say that?
lines.zh: : 为什么这么说？

lines.en: scene sanaatnight10
: Well cause...you know...you’d be doing stuff that couples do...
lines.zh: : 因为……你知道的……你们会做情侣之间会做的事……

lines.en: : And not only would it be with my mom, I’d have to figure out what to say to Ayane as well...
lines.zh: : 而且对象还是我妈妈，我还得想想要怎么跟Ayane说……

lines.en: : She really likes you and I think...she’d be really scared if you ever dated someone your age.
lines.zh: : 她真的很喜欢你，而且我觉得……你要是跟同龄人交往，她会很害怕。

lines.en: : So...she’d be okay with me dating someone her age?
lines.zh: : 所以……她倒是可以接受我跟她同龄的人交往？

lines.en: scene sanaatnight6
: Weirdly enough, I think she’d be more okay with that...
lines.zh: : 说来奇怪，我觉得她对那种情况反而更能接受……

lines.en: : Because to her, it would mean she still has a chance.
lines.zh: : 因为对她来说，那意味着自己还有机会。

lines.en: : I think what she’s most afraid of is you just...forgetting about her.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她最害怕的，其实是你就这么……把她忘了。

lines.en: : But I know you wouldn’t do that...
lines.zh: : 但我知道你不会那么做的……

lines.en: : You’re kinder than that, whether you believe it or not.
lines.zh: : 不管你信不信，你没有那么冷酷。

lines.en: No I’m not, Sana.
lines.zh: 不，Sana，我就是那么冷酷。

lines.en: You don’t know half of it.
lines.zh: 你连一半都不知道。

lines.en: It doesn’t matter how nice you are to someone if your end goal is to sleep with them.
lines.zh: 如果你的最终目的是把对方骗上床，那你怎么对她好都没有意义。

lines.en: But of course-
lines.zh: 不过当然——

lines.en: I won’t fault you for not realizing that yet.
lines.zh: 我不会怪你现在还没意识到这一点。

lines.en: I’ll be here for you until my veins run dry.
lines.zh: 只要我血管里还有一滴血，我就会守在你身边。

lines.en: else:
scene sanaatnight6
: Please...don’t do that either...
lines.zh: : 这个也……请你别做……

lines.en: : I think it would be best if everyone just...forgot all about grocery stores...forever.
lines.zh: : 我觉得大家最好……永远彻底忘掉杂货店这回事……

lines.en: : But then where would we buy our groceries?
lines.zh: : 那我们要去哪儿买日用品？

lines.en: : We wouldn’t. We’d all just die.
lines.zh: : 不买了。我们都饿死算了。

lines.en: : Are you really that embarrassed by that story?
lines.zh: : 那个故事真的让你这么难为情吗？

lines.en: : I swear it didn’t sound even half as stupid in my head...it was actually a really sad memory.
lines.zh: : 我发誓，在我脑子里它听上去连一半这么蠢都不到……那其实是一段很伤感的回忆。

lines.en: A gust of wind sweeps across the beach and, for a brief moment in time, I’m able to see both of Sana’s eyes.
lines.zh: 一阵风扫过海滩，有那么一瞬间，我看到了Sana的两只眼睛。

lines.en: They reflect the moonlight back into the sky, but not before giving me chills.
lines.zh: 它们把月光反射回天上，却先让我打了个寒颤。

lines.en: Though, that could just be the wind.
lines.zh: 不过，那也可能只是风的缘故。

lines.en: I didn’t catch much of her face, but I did spot a tiny glimpse of...emptiness?
lines.zh: 我没看清她大半张脸，但我确实瞥见了一丝……空洞？

lines.en: Longing?
lines.zh: 渴望？

lines.en: There’s something she wants, but can’t have.
lines.zh: 有什么她想要，却得不到的东西。

lines.en: I wonder what it is?
lines.zh: 我想知道那是什么？

lines.en: scene sanaatnight7
: Can you feel that, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你感觉到了吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : Yeah, it’s called wind.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那叫风。

lines.en: scene sanaatnight6
: That’s not what I meant...
lines.zh: : 我不是这个意思……

lines.en: : I meant the temperature.
lines.zh: : 我是说气温。

lines.en: : It's finally starting to get colder.
lines.zh: : 终于开始变凉了。

lines.en: scene sanaatnight7
: Summer is leaving us.
lines.zh: : 夏天要走了。

lines.en: : Pretty soon, we'll even have snow.
lines.zh: : 很快，我们甚至会迎来雪。

lines.en: : I wonder what else this winter will have in store for all of us?
lines.zh: : 不知道这个冬天还会给我们带来什么？

lines.en: : Do you like the winter, Sana?
lines.zh: : 你喜欢冬天吗，Sana？

lines.en: : I do...I was born in winter. It brings back good memories.
lines.zh: : 喜欢……我是在冬天出生的。它总能勾起美好的回忆。

lines.en: : I also don’t like the heat.
lines.zh: : 而且我也不喜欢热。

lines.en: : Neither do I. Here’s hoping that the two of us can manage to stay sane until-
lines.zh: : 我也不喜欢。希望我们两个能撑到——

lines.en: : Wait, don’t we have to deal with Fall before we get to winter? That didn’t even occur to me.
lines.zh: : 等等，冬天之前不是还得先过秋天吗？我居然完全没想到。

lines.en: scene sanaatnight3
: There is no Fall in Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : Kumon-mi 没有秋天。

lines.en: : Just like there is no Spring.
lines.zh: : 就像没有春天一样。

lines.en: : All we have are summer and winter.
lines.zh: : 我们只有夏天和冬天。

lines.en: : I’m...surprised you haven’t realized that until now.
lines.zh: : 我……挺惊讶你现在才发现。

lines.en: I know it’s been scorching hot ever since I was reborn here but...I never realized that was due to it being a six month Summer.
lines.zh: 我知道自从我在这里重生以来，天气一直热得要命，可是……我从没意识到那是因为夏天长达六个月。

lines.en: How does that even work?
lines.zh: 这到底是怎么回事？

lines.en: if ayanesleepover == True:
: Do you mind if I say something relatively corny right now?
lines.zh: : 我能说一句有点肉麻的话吗？

lines.en: : Go ahead...I’m listening.
lines.zh: : 说吧……我在听。

lines.en: : Have you ever realized that you and Ayane are kind of like summer and winter?
lines.zh: : 你有没有觉得，你和Ayane有点像夏天和冬天？

lines.en: scene sanaatnight11
: Pfft! What the heck?
lines.zh: : 噗！什么鬼？

lines.en: : I knew something corny was coming but...that sounds like a line from a movie.
lines.zh: : 我就知道要来一句肉麻的，不过……这听起来像是电影台词。

lines.en: scene sanaatnight12
: I...I know what you mean, though.
lines.zh: : 我……我明白你的意思。

lines.en: : Ayane is hyper and outdoorsy and loves adventure and I’m...
lines.zh: : Ayane活力四射、爱往外跑、喜欢冒险，而我……

lines.en: : Well, I’m Sana Sakakibara.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我是榊原Sana。

lines.en: : The quiet girl who doesn’t talk to anyone and spends all of her free time playing video games and eating melon bread.
lines.zh: : 那个不跟任何人说话、把所有空闲时间都用来打游戏和吃蜜瓜包的安静女生。

lines.en: : So I...can see why you’d think of us like the seasons.
lines.zh: : 所以……我能理解你为什么会把我们想成季节。

lines.en: scene sanaatnight7
: Since you had your turn, I’ll say something corny now too...
lines.zh: : 既然你说过了，那我也来说一句肉麻的吧……

lines.en: : Summer and winter...kind of need each other, don’t they?
lines.zh: : 夏天和冬天……是彼此需要的，对吧？

lines.en: : Without one, the other basically wouldn’t exist.
lines.zh: : 缺了一个，另一个基本上就不存在了。

lines.en: : The only reason we look forward to seasons changing is because we get tired of the one we have now.
lines.zh: : 我们之所以会期待季节更替，只是因为厌倦了眼下这一个。
: 所以……

lines.en: scene sanaatnight12
: So even if you like the Summer right now, you’ll look forward to me eventually, right?
lines.zh: : 所以就算你现在喜欢夏天，总有一天也会开始期待我的，对吧？

lines.en: scene sanaatnight13
: Oh God! That probably sounded really weird, didn’t it?
lines.zh: : 天哪！那听起来一定很奇怪吧？

lines.en: : Was that a confession, Sana?
lines.zh: : 那是告白吗，Sana？

lines.en: : No! I just meant that I...I don’t know!
lines.zh: : 不是！我只是想说……我不知道！

lines.en: : It just sort of came out! I’m obviously really bad at being corny!
lines.zh: : 它就这么冒出来了！我显然很不擅长说肉麻话！

lines.en: scene sanaatnight14
I take a seat next to Sana and move closer to her.
lines.zh: 我在Sana身边坐下，朝她靠近了些。

lines.en: She doesn’t try to get away.
lines.zh: 她没有躲开。

lines.en: Months ago, I feel like even coming within a few inches of her would have sent her sprinting down the beach.
lines.zh: 要是几个月前，光是靠近她几英寸，就足以让她沿着海滩狂奔而逃。

lines.en: But now-
lines.zh: 可现在——

lines.en: All she does is turn her head to the side and let out cute noises of embarrassment.
lines.zh: 她只是把头别到一边，发出几声可爱的羞窘声。

lines.en: : Ngh...
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯……

lines.en: : I...can’t believe I said something that stupid...
lines.zh: : 我……不敢相信自己说了那么蠢的话……

lines.en: : It wasn’t stupid. It was cute.
lines.zh: : 不蠢。很可爱。

lines.en: : No, it was very stupid. Very, very stupid.
lines.zh: : 不，非常蠢。非常非常蠢。

lines.en: : You should forget you ever heard it.
lines.zh: : 你应该当自己从没听过。

lines.en: : I don’t know if I’ll be able to do that.
lines.zh: : 我不知道自己做不做得到。

lines.en: : Please do that. Or, at the very least, never repeat it to Ayane.
lines.zh: : 那就请做到吧。或者至少，永远别跟Ayane复述。

lines.en: : She’d think I was trying to...win you over...or something...
lines.zh: : 她会以为我在……跟你抢……什么的……

lines.en: : Weren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你不是吗？

lines.en: : No. You’re my teacher. That’s weird.
lines.zh: : 不是。你是我的老师。那太奇怪了。

lines.en: : I don’t think it’s that weird.
lines.zh: : 我觉得没那么奇怪。

lines.en: : Of course you don’t. You...sleep in girls’ beds with them and stuff...
lines.zh: : 你当然不觉得。你……还会跟女生一起睡在人家床上什么的……

lines.en: scene sanaatnight15
: Is that a thing we need to talk about?
lines.zh: : 这件事需要谈一谈吗？

lines.en: : Is...that a thing you {i}want{/i} to talk about?
lines.zh: : 这……是你{i}想{/i}谈的事吗？

lines.en: : It sounds like it’s bothering you a little.
lines.zh: : 听起来它让你有点在意。

lines.en: : Of course it’s...bothering me a little.
lines.zh: : 我当然……有点在意。

lines.en: : I spent the whole night expecting you to...come visit me at the bar and...
lines.zh: : 我一整晚都在想你会不会……来酒吧找我，然后……

lines.en: : I come home to find you cuddling with Ayane...
lines.zh: : 结果我回到家，发现你和Ayane抱在一起……

lines.en: : It was...really weird...
lines.zh: : 那真的……很怪……

lines.en: : Would it have been better if I just let her stay by herself and cry her eyes out?
lines.zh: : 要是我就这么让她一个人哭到眼睛肿，你会更满意吗？

lines.en: scene sanaatnight14
: Of course not...You...You did the right thing.
lines.zh: : 当然不会……你……你做的是对的。

lines.en: : But that doesn’t make it...not weird for me...
lines.zh: : 可那并不代表……对我来说就不怪了……

lines.en: : It would be the same thing if I...found you in bed with my mom or something...
lines.zh: : 就像我要是……发现你和我妈妈躺在床上什么的……

lines.en: : If you ever find me in bed with your mom, I want you to know it’s probably her fault and not mine.
lines.zh: : 你要是哪天发现我躺在你的床上，我想让你知道那大概是她的错，不是我的。

lines.en: scene sanaatnight16
: Yeah...it probably would be...
lines.zh: : 嗯……大概确实是吧……

lines.en: : But...still...
lines.zh: : 可是……还是……

lines.en: : I thought I was okay with it, but for some reason, I just can’t...stop thinking about it...
lines.zh: : 我以为自己已经不在意了，可不知道为什么，我就是没法……不去想它……

lines.en: : It’s probably because I know how much she likes you and...
lines.zh: : 大概是因为我知道她有多喜欢你，而且……

lines.en: : Well, I don’t really know how {i}you{/i} feel, but I can’t imagine it’s...easy for a boy to turn down a girl like her if she’s...you know...
lines.zh: : 嗯，我不知道{i}你{/i}是什么感觉，但我想，一个男生要拒绝像她那样的女生，应该……你知道的……不容易。

lines.en: : Didn’t I tell you nothing happened that night?
lines.zh: : 我不是跟你说过那晚什么都没发生吗？

lines.en: scene sanaatnight15
: Mhm...but...
: You never said anything about other nights.
lines.zh: : 你可从没说过其他晚上的事。

lines.en: : And I don’t even want to ask because...I feel like it’s just better if I stay in the dark...
lines.zh: : 而我甚至不想问，因为……我觉得自己还是蒙在鼓里比较好……

lines.en: I feel that way too...
lines.zh: 我也这么觉得……

lines.en: scene sanaatnight14
: I’m sorry...I didn’t mean to start complaining...
lines.zh: : 抱歉……我不是有意抱怨的……

lines.en: : We’re on vacation...so we should be talking about happier things...
lines.zh: : 我们在度假……所以应该聊点开心的事……

lines.en: : Or just...not talking about anything and...watching the stars together...
lines.zh: : 或者干脆……什么都不聊，就……一起看星星……

lines.en: : That would be nice...wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: : 那样会很好……对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah.
: We can just watch the stars together.
lines.zh: : 我们就一起看星星吧。

lines.en: scene sanaatnight17
And so we watched the stars, like any two people awake at 3 AM would.
lines.zh: 于是我们看了星星，就像任何两个凌晨三点还醒着的人会做的那样。

lines.en: We sat there in silence, letting the cicadas off in the distance fill in the silent spaces that conversation would normally take up.
lines.zh: 我们静静地坐着，让远处的蝉鸣填满平时由对话占据的那些空白。

lines.en: And somehow or another, it felt like we were bonding.
lines.zh: 不知怎么的，感觉我们之间的距离近了。

lines.en: I’m glad Sana was able to look past the situation with Ayane and get over it so easily.
lines.zh: 我很高兴Sana能这么轻易地放下Ayane的事，跨过那道坎。

lines.en: She handled everything maturely and responsibly-
lines.zh: 她处理得成熟又负责任——

lines.en: Without even shedding a tear.
lines.zh: 连一滴眼泪都没掉。

lines.en: scene nightsky
Sana and I get up off of the ground almost 30 minutes later and head back to the inn together.
lines.zh: 差不多三十分钟后，我和Sana从地上爬起来，一起走回旅馆。

lines.en: I always forget how much taller I am than her until I see her right next to me.
lines.zh: 直到她站在我身边，我才会想起自己比她高出多少。

lines.en: But that’s part of what makes me so attracted to her.
lines.zh: 但这也正是她吸引我的原因之一。

lines.en: Call me a creep or whatever, but it makes sense in my eyes.
lines.zh: 要叫我变态什么的随你，反正在我看来这很合理。

lines.en: Even if I’m not devoted entirely to her, I’m happy that we can spend so much time together.
lines.zh: 就算我没有把全部心思都放在她身上，我也很高兴我们能一起度过这么多时光。

lines.en: : Um...S-Sensei?
lines.zh: : 嗯……老……Sensei？

lines.en: : Yeah?
: You...
: You didn’t hear anything while we were watching...the stars...did you?
lines.zh: : 我们看……星星的时候，你没听到什么吧？

lines.en: : All I heard were the cicadas.
lines.zh: : 我只听到了蝉鸣。

lines.en: : Okay...good.
lines.zh: : 是吗……那就好。

lines.en: : Let’s...um-
: Never mind...
lines.zh: : 算了……

lines.en: : I’ll...do my best to...try and forget...
lines.zh: : 我……会努力……试着忘掉……

lines.en: scene black
O world.
lines.zh: 哦，世界啊。

lines.en: In our final moments-
lines.zh: 在我们最后的时刻——

lines.en: Please remind us how it feels to be wanted without another unwanted in return.
lines.zh: 请提醒我们，被人需要是什么感觉，而不是反过来强求别人。

lines.en: And when we sleep-
lines.zh: 而当我们入睡——

lines.en: Gift us happy dreams.
lines.zh: 请赐予我们快乐的梦。

lines.en: Of places where nothing bad can ever happen.
lines.zh: 梦见什么坏事都不会发生的地方。

lines.en: And of a love so pure-
lines.zh: 梦见一份如此纯粹的爱——

lines.en: It destroys the world.
lines.zh: 足以毁灭世界。

lines.en: $ beachvacation9 = True
$ sana_love += 1
{i}Sana’s affection still manages to rise to [sana_love] despite spending the night worrying about what you do to her best friend while she is away!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}尽管Sana整晚都在担心，她不在的时候你对她最好的朋友做了什么，Sana的好感度还是升到了[sana_love]！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Oh, the tricks our hearts manage to play on us!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我们的心究竟对我们耍了什么花招啊！{/i}

lines.en: else:
: Well, either way, I’m glad we won’t have to deal with this heat anymore.
lines.zh: : 总之，不用再忍受这鬼天气了，我很高兴。

lines.en: scene sanaatnight3
: Me too...I’m excited to wear sweaters and hide under blankets and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我也是……我已经开始期待穿毛衣、躲进毯子里什么的了。

lines.en: : Yeah, those sound like two very 'Sana' activities.
lines.zh: : 是啊，听起来是很「Sana」的两件事。

lines.en: : You think you know me so well...
lines.zh: : 你以为你很了解我似的……

lines.en: : Nah. You just have a certain air to you. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 不。你只是有种特别的气质。就这样而已。

lines.en: : Well I hope it’s a chilly one...cause if one more hot breeze comes to get me and blows sand into my eyes I’m...taking the first bus out of here.
lines.zh: : 那我希望那气质是凉飕飕的……因为要是再有一阵热风把沙子吹进我眼睛里，我就……搭第一班巴士离开这儿。

lines.en: scene nightsky
Sana and I get up off the ground a few minutes later and head back to the inn together.
lines.zh: 几分钟后，我和Sana从地上爬起来，一起走回旅馆。

lines.en: I always forget how much taller I am than her until I see her right next to me.
lines.zh: 直到她站在我身边，我才会想起自己比她高出多少。

lines.en: But that’s part of what makes me so attracted to her.
lines.zh: 但这也正是她吸引我的原因之一。

lines.en: Call me a creep or whatever, but it makes sense in my eyes.
lines.zh: 要叫我变态什么的随你，反正在我看来这很合理。

lines.en: I feel a certain obligation to protect her from anything that would hurt her...Even if those things would make my life easier or better in the long run.
lines.zh: 我觉得自己有某种义务，要保护她远离任何会伤害她的东西……即使那些东西长远来看会让我的生活更轻松、更好。

lines.en: : Um...S-Sensei?
lines.zh: : 嗯……老……Sensei？

lines.en: : Yeah?
: I’m glad you couldn’t sleep tonight.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴你今晚睡不着。

lines.en: scene black
: Me too.
lines.zh: : 我也是。

$ sana_love += 1
{i}Sana’s affection has increased to [sana_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Sana 的好感度提升到了 [sana_love]!{/i}

lines.zh: {i}[totaldays] 天过去了……{/i}
